newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's Teleceara begun as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's Teleceara begun as buy.

text.p: Caspian Securities said it had started coverage of Brazilian telecommunications company Teleceara, a unit of federally-owned Telebras, with a buy rating.
-- also said it set a 1997 year-end price target at $160 and a 1998 year-end price target at $200.
-- Teleceara, which provides telecommunications services to the Brazilian northeastern state of Ceara, is traded on Brazil's SOMA over-the-counter market.

-- Analysts Tony Figueiredo and Joanne Showalter said in a report Teleceara "was the one of the most profitable subsidiaries in terms of return on equity in 1996, yielding an impressive 16 percent compared with 9 percent for Telebras."
-- "Despite share price appreciation of 126 percent since the beginning of the year, Teleceara's shares still trade at a significant discount to Telebras and other Latin peers," they said.
-- They also said they expect Teleceara to average net income growth of 19.5 percent over the next three years.
